weeklyLogs.tasks:
-Company introduction and tour around the office 
 -Familiarized the OSP ticketing system 
 -Assisted in checking asset inventory in workspace A, B, and C 
 -Joined company group chats to stay updated 
 -Updated the status of each company asset via Excel 
 -Assisted in rebooting CCTV hardware 
 -Accomplished the moving of PC Hardware from a workstation to another 
 -Changed the battery of hygrometer which is used to monitor the temperature inside the server room to prevent complications
weeklyLogs.takeaways:
During this period, I gained a well-rounded introduction to the company's operations, starting with an office tour that helped me understand the overall workflow and layout of the different workspaces.
I became familiar with the OSP ticketing system, which gave me a better grasp of how issues are logged, tracked, and resolved within the organization.
I also assisted in checking asset inventory across workspaces A, B, and C, which strengthened my attention to detail and helped me understand proper asset management practices.
Staying active in company group chats allowed me to keep up with updates and improve my communication within the team.
I further developed my documentation skills by updating the status of company assets through Excel, ensuring records stayed accurate and organized.
On the technical side, I assisted in rebooting CCTV hardware and helped move PC hardware between workstations, both of which gave me practical exposure to basic IT support tasks.
Lastly, I learned the importance of preventive maintenance by changing the battery of the hygrometer used to monitor server room temperature, helping me appreciate how small maintenance tasks play a big role in preventing larger technical complications.
